How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question — using Nurosym consistently and correctly helps you get the most out of it. 
Basic setup
Apply a small amount of moisture to the tragus (the small protrusion in front of your ear).
Place the earpiece on the left tragus, with the cable looping over and behind the ear to keep it stable. 
Start the session
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the energy level until you feel a light, pleasant tingling sensation in the ear.
During the session
You can sit, lie down, or continue normal activities like reading, working, or meditating. 
If the sensation becomes stronger or fades, adjust the intensity back to a light tingling.
Recommended routine
Use 30–60 minutes per day. 
Many people do one session in the morning or split it into:
• Morning after waking
• Evening before sleep
This daily routine helps integrate Nurosym into a consistent habit while allowing the stimulation to work alongside normal activities.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s recommended to speak with our clinical team before getting started.
